title: Extracting high molecular weight genomic DNA from Saccharomyces cerevisiae
protocol: Resuspend a yeast pellet in 4 ml Sorbitol 1M.
Incubate 30 min at 30°C (thermomixer program: 10 sec at 300 rpm each 10 min).
Centrifuge for 2 min and 30 seconds at 3000g.
Let the tube upside down to remove most of the liquid.
Resuspend the pellet in 3.5 ml lysis buffer.
Transfer the supernatant in two 15 ml tubes and repeat the last centrifugation.
Transfer the two supernatants in one 50 ml tube.
Add 1 volume of Isopropanol at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and dislodge pellet with 20 ml ethanol 70%.
Place on ice for at least 5 min.
Discard supernatant, remove as much ethanol as possible.
Let the pellet air dry for 5 min.
Incubate 10 min at 50°C without cap to evaporate remaining ethanol.
Transfer carefully with wide bore tip into a 1.5 ml tube.
